description: Azure Network ImportData — VNet + subnets + NAT topology.

applicationGatewaySubnetId.description: Dedicated subnet for classic Azure Application Gateway ingress.

applicationGatewaySubnetName.description: Dedicated subnet name for classic Azure Application Gateway ingress.

containerAppsSubnetName.description:
Subnet delegated to `Microsoft.App/environments` for the Container Apps environment.
Absent for a BYO-VNet, whose private subnet serves the environment.

egressPublicIps.description: NAT public addresses owned by setup; empty for an unknown external egress path.

isByoVnet.description: True when the VNet is owned outside this stack.

natGatewayId.description: NAT gateway resource id when one was created.

networkSecurityGroupId.description: Network Security Group resource id attached to workload subnets.

privateEndpointSubnetName.description:
Dedicated subnet name for Private Endpoints (e.g. Postgres Flexible Server). Distinct from
the Container Apps infrastructure ("private") subnet, which a Private Endpoint cannot share.

oneOf.description: Setup-owned sandbox and internal gateway subnet coordinates.

gatewayCidrs.description: Gateway ranges allowed by the sandbox subnet NSGs on TCP3128 and TCP3129.

gatewaySubnetIds.description: Undelegated subnet reserved for the gateway load balancer's frontend.

sandboxCidrs.description: Sandbox source ranges allowed on the proxy listener.

sandboxCidrsByResource.description: Dedicated source ranges keyed by Sandbox resource id for exact linked-resource access.

sandboxSubnetIds.description: Dedicated delegated subnets whose sandboxes use the gateway.

vpcCidrs.description: Every VNet range excluded from gateway destinations.

workloadCidrs.description: Workload source ranges allowed on the authenticated admin listener.

subnetIds.description: Subnet resource ids in this VNet used by workloads.

vnetId.description:
VNet resource id (full ARM path). Absent when the controller
will look up the default VNet at runtime.
